versions.content: The FlexRay State Manager shall implement one state machine for each FlexRay cluster. The states of this state machine are to some extent derived from the POC states of the FlexRay CC. This document is based on the assumption that there is always a unique POC state for every FlexRay cluster (see Limitations in section 4.1). The state machine of each cluster is processed by the main function FrSM_MainFunction_<FrSMCluster.ShortName> assigned to that cluster (see section 8.5.1). However, as defined in section 8.3.2 , some transitions of the state machine are processed in the context of the FrSM_RequestComMode function in order to achieve a deterministic behavior for shutdown.
